sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 6235 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 74 units parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; no minimum stay (DEC's reservation minimum here is 1 night). Permits run to 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any DEC campground.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/frontier-town-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=6235 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'LENGTH OF STAY -Your camping permit can be issued for a maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground.') + DEC 2026 campground summary (Frontier Town 'RES MIN' 1), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 50-amp electric on the 13-site Stagecoach RV/Trailer Loop (R034-R046) and the Blacksmith Equestrian Loop; the Prairie Junction Loop has no electric. No full-hookup sites.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 6235 (Stagecoach RV/Trailer Loop and Blacksmith Equestrian Loop sites 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp'; Prairie Junction Loop 'Electric Hookup - no'; 'Full Hookup - no' on all), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC's 2026 summary lists 77 campsites; the ReserveAmerica description says 91 (equestrian, RV/trailer, tent and group) and its site list has 71 campsites plus 3 group camps. Listed equipment lengths 15-40 ft; one 30-ft pull-through in Prairie Junction, the rest back-in.

sites.source: DEC 2026 campground summary (Frontier Town '# OF CAMP SITES' 77) + https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/frontier-town-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=6235 ('91 campsites (equestrian, RV/trailer, tent and group sites)'; 'Campsite (71)', 'Group Camp (3)') + ReserveAmerica site list (Equip length/Driveway '40 Back-In' 23, '30 Pull-Through' 1, ...), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/frontier-town-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=6235 ('hot showers, flush toilets, picnic areas, picnic pavilions, playgrounds, and trailer dump station'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC (Adirondacks, North Hudson; opened 2020 on the site of the old Frontier Town theme park). RVs and trailers have their own Stagecoach RV/Trailer Loop (electric) and can also use the non-electric Prairie Junction Loop; the Blacksmith Equestrian Loop is the horse camp. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 6235) and DEC's 2026 summary: reservable, 9-month window incl. same day, no minimum, 14-night permits (14 cumulative nights Jul 1 - Labor Day), max rig 40 ft, dump; added 50-amp electric (RV and equestrian loops), a pull-through, showers and flush toilets; sites 91 (note) -> 77 (DEC 2026 summary). Season (2027 May 14 - Oct 10) and $25 fee left as read. RVs are not confined to the horse loop. Note trimmed of field facts. The electric-site add-on is not priced in DEC's summary.
flags: Phone conflict: entry has 518-532-7117; DEC's 2026 Summer Recreation Campground Summary lists Frontier Town at 518-532-9051.

Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): the ReserveAmerica description puts the 91-acre facility 'on the shores of the Schroon River' with a picnic area along the shore; the entry is 'not waterfront'. The claim is about the property, not the campsites.
